segments.t: Denis comforts a weeping Katya and urges her not to give up. When Nikita returns from Saint Petersburg, Katya tries to confess her feelings for Denis, but Nikita announces that his father will pay for the entire operation—sealing Katya's sacrifice.
Почему в жизни всё так несправедливо?
И проблемы у нас теперь общие.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Почему в жизни всё так несправедливо?
'Why is everything in life so unfair?' The grammar packs 'why' and 'unfair' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'A person's life depends on pieces of paper.' Katya anchors the line on 'life', while 'pieces of paper' completes the thought. Denis answers right away.
'Stop crying, it is too early to give up.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'stop' before landing on 'to give up'.
'We will definitely think of something else.' The meaning hinges on 'we' working together with 'to think up' in spoken Russian.
'Katya, Nikita is looking for you over there.' Denis addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'is looking for'. Katya answers right away.
'Nikita, we need to talk right now.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Nikita' and finishing on 'to talk'.
'I spoke with my father.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'father' without extra filler words.
'He will pay for this operation in full.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'he' before landing on 'the operation'.
И проблемы у нас теперь общие.
'And our problems are now shared.' Nikita anchors the line on 'and', while 'shared' completes the thought.
'I need to do a report urgently.' Nikita anchors the line on 'to me', while 'to do' completes the thought.
'Forgive me, I could not say it.' The '-a' ending on the past-tense verb for 'could' marks a female speaker or subject. Denis answers right away.

'Love also depends on pieces of paper.' The meaning hinges on 'love' working together with 'pieces of paper' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Почему в жизни всё так несправедливо?
И проблемы у нас теперь общие.
To save her father's life, Katya stays engaged to Nikita, setting up the dramatic wedding showdown in the next episode. See you next time!
